name: Planning Commission Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
Planning Commission Regular Meeting
44933 Fern Avenue, Lancaster, California 93534
A G E N D A
LANCASTER PLANNING COMMISSION
REGULAR MEETING
Monday, September 15, 2008
06:00 p.m.
Council Chambers - Lancaster City Hall
The Commission Secretary hereby declares that the agenda was posted by at the entrance to the Lancaster City Hall Council Chambers.
AGENDA REVIEW
Planning Conference Room – Large
MEETING ASSISTANCE INFORMATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, this meeting will be held at a location accessible to persons with disabilities; if you need special assistance to participate in this public meeting please contact the City Clerk at (661) 723-6020. TDD users may call the California TDD Relay Service at 1-800-735-2922. Services such as American Sign Language interpreters, a reader during the meeting, auxiliary aids, large print copies of the agenda and/or translation assistance for non-English speakers are available upon reasonable and timely request. To ensure availability, you are advised to make your request at least 72 hours prior to the meeting/event you wish to attend. Due to difficulties in securing sign language interpreters, five or more business-day notice is strongly recommended. For additional information, please contact the City Clerk at (661) 723-6020.
AGENDA ADDENDUM INFORMATION
On occasion items may be added after the agenda has been mailed to subscribers. Copies of the agenda addendum item will be available at the Planning Department and are posted with the agenda on the windows of the City Council Chambers. For more information, please call the Planning Department at (661) 723-6020.
CALL TO ORDER
INVOCATION
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR
If an individual is unable to stay through the entire meeting due to extenuating circumstances, a total of ten (10) minutes is provided at this time during which input may be given regarding agenda items. Individual speakers are limited to two (2) minutes each.
Any person who would like to address the Planning Commission on any agendized item is requested to complete a speaker card for the Recording Secretary, and identify the agenda item you would like to discuss. Each person will be given an opportunity to address the Planning Commission at the time such item is discussed by the Planning Commission. Speaker cards are available at the rear of the Council Chambers. Individual speakers are limited to three (3) minutes each.
UNCONTESTED PUBLIC HEARING
The oral staff report will not be presented if: 1) no one in the audience wishes to speak in opposition to the item to be heard; 2) the applicant has reviewed the staff report and agrees to abide by the conditions recommended in the report; and 3) the members of the Commission wish to waive the staff report. The Chairman will then entertain a motion to act on the item.
CONSENT CALENDAR
1.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES - Minutes from the Regular Meeting of August 18, 2008; and Minutes from the Special Meeting of September 2, 2008.
CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARINGS
2.
Conditional Use Permit No. 07-05
Applicant:
Kaley Aboul-Hosn
Location:
.71± gross acres located on the northwest corner of Avenue J and 17th Street West
Request:
To construct a 988 square-foot coffee shop and a 3,327 square-foot carwash with a cashier and waiting area in the CPD Zone
Recommendation:
Grant the applicant an additional 60-day extension to the November 17, 2008, Planning Commission Hearing
3.
General Plan Amendment No. 04-05, Zone Change No. 04-06, Tentative Tract Map No. 62757
Applicant:
Pacific Land Co.
Location:
160± gross acres located at the southeast corner of 70th Street West and Avenue J
Request:
1. Certification of the Environmental Impact Report; 2. Amend General Plan land use designation for the subject property from NU (Non-Urban Residential; 0.4 to 2.0 dwelling units per acre) to UR (Urban Residential; 2.1 to 6.5 dwelling units per acre); 3. Rezone the property from RR 2.5 (Rural Residential, minimum lot size 2.5 acres) to R-7,000 (Single Family Residential, minimum lot size 7,000 square feet); 4. A subdivision to create 650 single family lots in the proposed R-7,000 Zone
Recommendation:
Continue General Plan Amendment No. 04-05, Zone Change No. 04-06, Tentative Tract Map No. 62757 and Environmental Impact Report No. 06-06 indefinitely, and withdraw applicant’s request to be heard at the September 15, 2008, meeting
NEW PUBLIC HEARINGS
4.
ONE-YEAR EXTENSIONS
a.
Conditional Use Permit No. 05-27
Applicant:
Agape Church
Location:
10± gross acres located on the southwest corner of Lancaster Boulevard and 18th Street East
Request:
Construct a church facility, a 16,982 square-foot sanctuary, and a 9,000 square-foot activity center in the R-7,000 Zone
Recommendation:
Grant a one-year extension to September 18, 2009, based on the findings contained in the staff report and subject to added Condition Nos. 24-27 and all other previously approved conditions
5.
Conditional Use Permit No. 04-10 Amended
Applicant:
Rob Martin, Martin Properties
Location:
15.0± acres located at the southwest corner of Avenue J-8 and 20th Street West in the CPD Zone
Request:
Modify Condition No. 25 to - 1. Allow a maximum 30-foot-high pylon sign to be located on either 20th Street West or Avenue J-8; 2. Allow the number and height of center freestanding signs to be determined through approval of an overall sign program
Recommendation:
Adopt Resolution No. 08-24 approving Conditional Use Permit No. 04-10 Amended to delete Condition No. 25 and allow the 30-foot-high pylon sign
6.
Conditional Use Permit No. 08-08
Applicant:
Eugenio Gonzalez
Location:
1009-1011 West Avenue I
Request:
A Conditional Use Permit to establish a restaurant within an existing commercial building that is classified as a "primary on-sale alcoholic beverage establishment" (Type 41) and includes live entertainment in the Commercial Zone
Recommendation:
Adopt Resolution No. 08-25 approving Conditional Use Permit No. 08-08
7.
Conditional Use Permit No. 08-13
Applicant:
Danny Fiarella (Giovanni’s Italian Deli and Delights)
Location:
42035 10th Street West Unit #105, Lancaster (northwest corner of 10th Street West and Avenue M)
Request:
A Conditional Use Permit to allow for the on-site sale and consumption of alcohol, (Type 41, sale of beer and wine for a bona fide restaurant) in the LI (Light Industrial) Zone
Recommendation:
Adopt Resolution No. 08-26 approving Conditional Use Permit No. 08-13
8.
Conditional Use Permit No. 08-15
Applicant:
Chantel Kilmer
Location:
730 West Lancaster Boulevard
Request:
A Conditional Use Permit for a 1,500 square-foot wine room that would offer wine tasting and wine sales in the Central Business District. The required alcohol licenses would be a Type 20 (off sale beer and wine - to purchase) and a Type 42 (on sale beer and wine - wine tasting)
Recommendation:
Adopt Resolution No. 08-27 approving Conditional Use Permit No. 08-15
9.
Tentative Tract Map No. 66558
Applicant:
Avenue L Partners, LLC
Location:
6.89± gross acres located on the south side of Avenue L and approximately 453 feet west of 10th Street West
Request:
A subdivision of 5 industrial lots in the Light Industrial Zone
Recommendation:
Adopt Resolution No. 08-28 approving Tentative Tract Map No. 66558
10.
Tentative Tract Map No. 69294
Applicant:
Michael and Susan Ossola
Location:
2.3± gross acres located between Avenue L-12 and Avenue L-14, and approximately 336 feet west of 10th Street West
Request:
A one-lot subdivision for 21 industrial airspace condominium units in the LI Zone
Recommendation:
Adopt Resolution No. 08-29 approving Tentative Tract Map No. 69294
DIRECTOR'S ANNOUNCEMENTS
COMMISSION AGENDA
PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR - NON -AGENDIZED ITEMS
This portion of the agenda allows an individual the opportunity to address the Commission on any subject regarding City business. Under State legislation, no action can be taken on non-agenda items. Members of the public should be aware of this when addressing the Commission regarding items not specifically referenced on the agenda. Please complete a speaker card for the Recording Secretary. Individual speakers are limited to three (3) minutes each.
ADJOURNMENT
The meeting is adjourned to Monday, September 29, 2008, at 6 p.m., in the Council Chambers for a Special Meeting of the Planning Commission to review and discuss proposed revisions to the City of Lancaster General Plan as part of the City-wide General Plan Update Process.
